item.title: Call Of Duty On Switch 2 Has Two Different Upscaling Options

description.p: Here's an early explainer on the difference.Our impressions of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign went live yesterday alongside early access for anyone who pre-ordered the game. The full launch comes on Friday 23rd October, but buying now unlocks access to the full campaign before the multiplayer modes.As you may know if you've played the Switch 2 version already, buried in the Graphics settings are two different upscaling options. One is Nvidia's AI-powered DLSS upscaler, and the other is Infinity Ward's in-house anti-aliasing solution, labelled "Filmic SMAA T2X".Read the full article on nintendolife.com

description.p: [Insert funny Shrek joke here].Aspyr Media, the team behind the recent Lord of the Rings and Middle-earth ports for Nintendo platforms, has apparently got a remaster of Shrek 2 in the pipeline. item.title: Preview: 'Eternal Anima' Returns To The Past To Create A Modern JRPG

description.p: Back to the future.Originally revealed in 2023 as a working title named Project Life is RPG, Marvelous didn't show too much of their new IP, but said they were creating a game that pays respect to the classics of the genre, along with some gorgeous concept art. Jump forward to this year, and Eternal Anima was officially unveiled in September's Nintendo Direct.A bunch of game industry veterans are working on this title, such as Katsuhisa Higuchi (Final Fantasy, Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, Xenogears), Kazushige Nojima (Final Fantasy, Kingdom Hearts), and Keisuke Makino (Metaphor: ReFantazio, Persona 5), to name a few.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
